_: The third-party works the page ships, and the credit lines its data's licences ask for, shown on the Credits screen (web/credits.js) beside the map's own sources (web/data/shibuya/scene.json `sources`). One list: README.md "Data and licences" says the same in prose. `kind` is the row's short label; `text` is the licence's text as shipped under web/; tools/credits_check.py fails on one that is missing.

own.name: Score and sound
own.text: Written for Blue Hour and synthesised by the page's own code as it plays. No recordings and no samples; the loading music is the same score, rendered to a file.

own.name: Models
own.text: The hero level, the vehicles, the trains, the trees and the Akita are modelled for Blue Hour from published dimensions and photographs, with no third-party models.

own.name: Story
own.text: A work of fiction. Its people are invented; signs, screens and shop fronts are indicative.
